Brailiv Oldest Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This is the oldest of Brailiv's three documented Jewish cemeteries, confirmed in use by the early 20th century though completely destroyed, according to local testimony, during WWII; private housing now covers the site. During the ESJF's survey, drone photography was halted after local residents expressed discomfort with continued filming — a detail preserved here as it reflects the survey's own working methods. Brailiv's Jewish community, numbering 3,721 (43 percent of the town) by 1897, suffered a series of devastating massacres in 1942: 1,200 were executed on February 13 alone, followed by 180 more that April and a final group of 503 on August 25.
